_readme: EXAMPLE DATA — replace with your company's real services, prices, and pricing rules before sending anything to a real prospect. Structure (service_id, service_name, base_price_eur, pricing_rules, good_fit_for, description) must stay the same shape since generate_proposal.py and the system prompt rely on it.

services.description: Dedicated search for a single senior/leadership hire (director level and above), with a named lead recruiter and a structured shortlist process.
services.pricing_rules: Fee is 30% of the role's estimated first-year total compensation, with base_price_eur as the minimum fee regardless of salary. Billed in three installments: 1/3 on engagement, 1/3 on shortlist delivery, 1/3 on placement. Use this tier only for single named leadership/director+ hires, not volume hiring.
good_fit_for: single senior or leadership hire (director, VP, C-level)
prospect has struggled to fill the role internally or via a generalist agency

services.description: Per-placement recruitment for individual contributor and manager-level roles, no upfront retainer — fee due only on a successful hire.
services.pricing_rules: Fee is 18% of the placed candidate's first-year base salary, invoiced on the candidate's start date. No base_price_eur retainer for this service — use this tier for standard IC/manager roles rather than director+ or volume hiring, where the retained or RPO tiers apply instead.
good_fit_for: prospect wants to pay only on results, not a retainer
1-3 open roles, not a sustained hiring program

services.description: An embedded recruiter working a defined set of open roles for the prospect over a rolling monthly engagement — for companies hiring continuously rather than for one-off roles.
services.pricing_rules: Monthly fee of base_price_eur per active requisition slot (i.e., 2 concurrent roles = 2x base_price_eur/month), minimum 3-month engagement. Scale the number of slots to the prospect's stated hiring volume/timeline — do not quote this tier for a single one-off hire.
good_fit_for: hiring 5+ people over a quarter or opening a new office/team
recurring or seasonal hiring volume, not a single role
prospect explicitly mentions a hiring plan, headcount target, or expansion timeline

services.service_name: Back Office as a Service (Payroll & HR Admin)
services.description: Ongoing payroll processing, contract administration, and HR compliance support for a prospect's existing team, so they don't need to build an internal back-office function.
services.pricing_rules: Monthly fee is base_price_eur minimum, or EUR 55 per managed employee per month, whichever is higher. Quote this alongside a hiring-focused service only when the prospect is also growing a local team and will need ongoing admin support for the people being hired, not as a standalone recommendation for a pure hiring need.
good_fit_for: opening a local entity/office and needs payroll & compliance support
growing team without an internal HR/admin function yet
prospect mentions administrative overhead, compliance, or back-office pain points

services.description: A fixed 6-8 week engagement to audit and refresh the prospect's careers page, employee value proposition, and job post content, to improve candidate response rates.
services.pricing_rules: Flat project fee of base_price_eur, billed 50% on engagement / 50% on delivery. Recommend this only when research or notes indicate the prospect already has a hiring process but is struggling with candidate volume/quality/employer perception — not as a first recommendation for a prospect with no stated hiring activity.
good_fit_for: prospect mentions weak candidate response, low applicant quality, or employer brand/perception issues
prospect has an existing careers page or job posts that read as generic or outdated
complements a recruitment or RPO engagement rather than replacing one

services.description: A senior recruiter/TA lead working a fixed number of days per month to build or fix the prospect's internal hiring process, interview structure, and hiring manager enablement.
services.pricing_rules: Day rate is base_price_eur per day, minimum 2 days/month, minimum 3-month engagement. Recommend this when the prospect wants to build internal hiring capability rather than outsource hiring entirely — do not combine with RPO for the same roles, since they solve the same problem two different ways.
good_fit_for: prospect wants to build/improve their own internal hiring process, not outsource it
early-stage company hiring its first internal recruiter/HR hire
prospect mentions inconsistent interview process or no dedicated hiring owner
